card.text: M52 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 1,571 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 52 or M52, also known as NGC 7654 or the Scorpion Cluster, is an open cluster of stars in the highly northern constellation of Cassiopeia.

introduction.text: M52 is drawn as 1,008 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
